reviews.text: Dr was very knowledgeable, he and his assistant learned the best way to approach my dog for her vaccines. Dr took time to ask questions about Hazel to know more of her background and provide me with good feedback on questions I had. Would recommend this vet office!
Always happy with services

Dr. L is the best veterinarian! I highly appreciate his knowledgeable and honest approach to animal care. He and his staff are incredibly caring, compassionate, and well-trained in pet health. I only bring my animals to Canyon Veterinary Clinic and highly recommend them whenever I have the opportunity.
The care of the staff was amazing. Dr Leslie spent a lot of time with my dog to uncover the issues!!

Didn't help my dog when something could have been done, also called my boy dog with balls (I might add) a girl . My dog couldn't even lift his head and they left us in the room for an hour just about, to test for parvo. which it wasn't and all he needed was to be on an IV bag. It was just talk talk talk do 1 test let him die right then and there in the room and charge us $300 and we took him home and buried him. I will 100% not be going back there ever again. I don't remember when they changed doctors because they used to be really good with our animals, but now I think we have 3 animals there that were treated poorly since the change. It makes me sick. also a side note the receptionist at the time didn't seem to care either kind of like a dull character that didn't have sympathy.

Always accommodating, and so good to my furry babies, great staff, and this last visit was a very sad visit, and Dr Galvin has been so supportive and compassionate, as well as the rest if the staff that was there at one of the worst time of an animal lover😪 …

Dr Leslie did it again! My poor Bonzai kitty was screaming in Pain and Dr leslie made emergency time to see him first thing in the morning. Bonzai was blocked up and so constipated he could have never have passed it on his own. So Bonzai spent all day at Canyon Animal Hospital and received 2 enima's & medicine and Blood work and 6 days later my baby is better than ever! DR Leslie even follows l up with having me send 3 emails amnd pictures to follow up on Bonzai's progress. Thank you DR Leslie and staff! You guys ROCK!

Very knowledgable and friendly staff with plenty of experience. We have been using Canyon Animal Hospital for 30+ years. When Dr. Foster sold the business to Drs. Hehn we could have decided to take our pets elsewhere. But, we decided to give the new vets the opportunity to show us what they can do, and we're glad we did. We think highly of Drs. Lori and Kelly Hehn and their staff. The Hehns sold the practice to Dr. Leslie, and the level of treatment has remained excellent.

My dog has been going to this location her entire life (13+ years). Blessed are the days when DVM A.N. Vann owned the facility. Once he retired / sold the facility it has gone down hill. Today a "stand in" person, who I will not dignify with a title, with an arrogant and condencending, interacted with me and my pet. The facility would better servce their clients if they closed vs having him be the face of the location. I refuse to go in when this "temp" person is there.
I was really impressed with the professionalism and courtesy of the veterinarian and vet tech at the practice.  Great experience with their team!

The staff got my sick boy in the same day I called.  It was a long holiday and I  was nothing but grateful.  Teddy is a bit hard to diagnose but he is doing much better.  Still trying to figure his problem out.  Thank you from the bottom of my heart to Dr. Leslie and his staff.
We live close to this vet, Hank out 10 mo old yellow lab love the staff and the Dr. I highly recommend canyon Fair prices great care !!!  give themm a try

We are so grateful for the exceptional care and compassion provided by Dr. Leslie and the entire staff. Everyone is kind, professional, and genuinely caring toward both us and our pet. Dr. Leslie takes the time to thoroughly explain everything, answer all our questions, and make sure we feel comfortable with the treatment plan.

His compassion, knowledge, and patience are outstanding. It’s clear that Dr. Leslie and his staff truly love animals, and they treat every pet as if they were their own.  We always feel heard, informed, and confident that our pet is receiving exceptional care. He also has a great sense of humor!

The level of attention, patience, and dedication he shows is rare and deeply appreciated. We always leave feeling confident that our pet received the very best care.

We highly recommend this veterinarian to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate, and trustworthy veterinary team. Not to mention, Dr. Leslie is a riot!
Dr. was very thorough. I appreciate that he showed me exactly what had happened.  I really like this veterinary business.
Friendly veterinary service!

I am very happy with Dr. Leslie as well as the staff members at
Canyon Animal.  Front Desk is very efficient and friendly.  Dr. Leslie takes his time as soon as he enters the room and always
answers questions thoroughly.  I would highly recommend this
clinic as they are all professional, friendly and respectful!

When Dr. Kelly was there, this was a fabulous establishment. I would go in there with such confidence leave my pet in the hands of their care and not worry. When Dr. Leslie took over their technicians were horrific. They laid my seven-year-old dog on his back for a sanitary shave and traumatized him and it took two weeks to get over this. He was still hiding under the chair. Whatever text they hired who is there she was so rude and did not have the empathy that is needed for animals and I remember she came out and said oh my God I’ve got fluid all over my hands. Apparently my dog either urinated or had an issue because this stupid individual put him on his back. I was horrified absolutely horrified. My heart broke into pieces and was shattered. I went in there for a sanitary shave and a nail trim and I had going into Dr. Kelly to do that for at least five or six years, and I would come in at four and I’d leave at 4:15 and Jagger was gleeful my dog. They had him in there for an hour and I finally had to go up and say where is my Animal? What have you done to him? Where is he and they said oh he’s wiggling around a lot. And then I found out he was on his back. When Kelly was there, one tech would hold him in his arms and the other one would just do a shave they laid him on his back unbelievable. It was the worst thing I’ve ever seen when he came running out. He was so distressed thank God I got him because they even put his harness on wrong. Missing one leg and he could’ve run out onto 32nd St. and Ben killed. He was so distressed. I never went back.

Very kind people. They are amazing with my Abby.  Always willing to help and answer all of my questions.   I would recommend to anyone wanting to have their animals well taken care of and they have great pricing

Olmost 2 yrs now, and every staff member cares, loves, and takes their job with love, passion,kindness, and caring Ness.  My pet i would never take anywhere else, less ofcourse its emergency and distance won't allow such. Dr Leslie was a Lil confused because when I got her there, she got down, held her self up walked.  That was not the case prior to that.  Dr Leslie took her home(rarely does) but he wanted to see for himself.  I don't know one vet that would ever think of doing that.   I'll be 4 ever greatful for Dr lelie doing that. I was so comfortable with brookz with him, I knew what better person could she be monitored by other then Dr Leslie.  Next day, I came in. Bloodwork came back all negative!! And she was bank to normal. God bless Dr lelie and his staff.  Ill b 4 ever greatful!!  Thank you again!!​

I love this place so much. Dr Leslie is the absolute best and truly cares about animals. I've tried so many vets over the years and always feel like they care more about their wallets than they do the animals. You will absolutely not have that experience here. Highly recommend.
They were really helpful and even noticed things we didnt and explained really well.

We sadly had to put our dog down today, but I can't imagine working with a better team. Everyone there was so kind, the vet was in the room right away. You never want to make this vet trip, but I'm glad we chose to do it here. Would give 10 stars if I could.

Loved Dr. Leslie Roxy and his kind and fun personality. He really took his time with my pup, he sat on the ground with her, gave her cheez wiz to gain her trust. Very knowledgeable and compassionate practice.

I was able to get a prompt Monday morning appointment to help my cat suffering from a urinary infection. She was examined & handled carefully & started on the antibiotics.
The staff were helpful & Dr Leslie took time to explain everything.

I love Canyon Animal Hospital! The staff and Dr Roxy are so professional and kind to Joey, my Boston terrier. He loves going to the office and gets so much attention! I am very picky about where I bring Joey and every time I have had an appointment I don’t worry because I know he is getting the best care! A clean, friendly  environment and I trust the doctors and staff. Joey is a patient for life and I’m so lucky to have a great office to take him to for all of his needs!! Top notch practice❤️❤️

We love this practice and will never go anywhere else. They take time to really check out your pet and tell you what's going on. I love that we can communicate through email and they are very affordable. What more could you ask?!

Very welcoming, clean, courteous, friendly, easy to talk to, caring ❤. I called with my moms dog being sick they gave me same day appointment. Our regular vet said no appointments for 2 weeks.  Definitely changing to Canyon Animal Hospital. Very reasonable prices. Absolutely 💯 recommend here. Smokey is doing so much better. Thank you 😊 💓. He also loves coming in for nail trims.
Amazing staff, great with the animals, highly recommend

I love canyon animal hospital. My dog is with them since he was puppy and my dog is already four years old. The girls are so nice and welcome since you entered the door they are very patience with my dog. The doctors are amazing they go over everything with you and answer all your questions. Thanks for everything.
Very caring staff and doctors

Dr. Leslie and his staff are intelligent and kind. Dr. Leslie has been in practice for a long time and knows what he's doing. I had taken my dog to another practice closer to where I live, and that practice told me that my dog needed almost $2000 worth of dental work, including extractions and x-rays. Instead of paying Scottsdale prices, I came to see Dr. Leslie, and guess what? My dog didn't need ANY extractions or x-rays. Her teeth are healthy and, now, are clean.
Stay away from vet practices that say your pet needs x-rays. In most cases, they do not and it's just a way for the vet to jack up the bill.
My dog also had some tummy issues and Dr. Leslie took time out of his schedule to meet with me and get my dog on the right track-even though we were only there for the dental cleaning.
Just go see him. You won't regret it!

What special people here...they helped my little dog who had been suffering from a ear infection for months while my OLD vet did nothing but change me for no help...here's to my new vets for all.my.fur babies

Everyone at this animal hospital was absolutely amazing, from the first phone call to the last visit! Our dog ended up needing emergency surgery for her small intestine as she had swallowed a part of her chew toy and it had gotten stuck. The ER Vet hospital originally quoted us a ton of money for the surgery which we weren't able to afford. We began calling all animal hospitals/clinics across the valley right before 5pm to see if anyone would be able to get our pup in. Adrienne answered the phone and was a sweetheart! She told us they would be able to get our dog in for the surgery the very next morning for half the cost that the ER hospital quoted us at. Brought our pup in the next morning and they redid some x-rays to confirm the piece was still in the same spot. Dr. Leslie himself called us and spoke to us about everything and then they got her into the surgery. Came in later that afternoon to pick our pup up and spoke to Adrienne who went over all the aftercare and prescribed dog food instructions (which they gave us at a GREAT price). Our pup was all healed and Dr. Leslie spoke to us about what to expect following the surgery. The follow up appointment was quick and easy to get her stitches out as well. The entire team took such great care of our pup, and she healed with no complications and is back to running around and playing as if nothing ever happened! We truly can't thank everyone at Canyon Animal Hospital enough, you saved our pup! If you need anything, this is the place to go for your pets!

By far the best experience I have ever had with a veterinary team/Vet they deserve more than 5 🌟. They care as much about BronXX as I do! The team is amazing! I REFUSE to go anywhere else.
I have never had a vet, allow me to send a video to evaluate the concern to see if my dog needs to be seen or if they can give me some insight on the situation.

They do follow up calls and answer any concerns you may have.
They listen and love your pet. Very appreciative BronXX is  apart of Canyon Animal Hospital.
We love Canyon Animal Hospital. The staff is very attentive to our needs and really has my dark. Charlie's best Interest, we love going there.
We love doctor Roxy Leslie as our vet but the assistants have been really hit or miss.

Dr. Leslie and his staff are the absolute best to work with. We moved from this side of town all the way to Gilbert and drive our pets out there 40 minutes because we love them at this office. The staff truly listens to your concerns and care about your pets. They took care of our EDM and Angelique and did everything they could to make them comfortable. Their prices are also much more reasonable than any other vet. We even had a follow- up email checking on our little girl when she was not feeling well. You will receive the absolute best care for your babies here.

When I brought Cooper in for his vomiting and diarrhea, Dr. Anderson was very thorough and explained everything to me. The following day Dr. Leslie followed up with an email. Cooper is back to normal and a happy Golden Retriever today!! 😊 …
Love everyone at Canyon Animal Hospital! They are quick to get us in and get back to us. Staff is personable and helpful. Couldn’t recommend more!

We have been bringing our pets to Canyon Animal Hospital for years now and we loved the previous owners. We were very sad when they left but Dr. Leslie and his team have been absolutely amazing!! He is such a caring and compassionate veterinarian and always goes above and beyond!!
The staff is so nice and helpful. They made my puppy feel very happy. Definitely recommend!
Friendly staff and very reasonable prices
We had the the most amazing experience as Dr Bandit could've provided.  Very reasonable prices and great staff.

And I need to add that the staff rocks (shout out to Brooke)! They care every bit as much as Dr. L and Dr. G. do and they will do their best to fit you in as soon as you need it.

Thank you Dr Vernor and staff for taking care of our family on that tragic day.  You provided peace and comfort when there was little to be found.
